brief:
Palestinian journalist Abed Abu Shehadeh was released from Israeli custody after five days in detention, Democracy Now! reported. Abu Shehadeh, a prominent Palestinian citizen of Israel, had been held by Israeli authorities.

Following his release, Abu Shehadeh spoke publicly about his experience, emphasizing the need for courage in continuing journalistic work under such circumstances. Details of the charges or stated reasons for his detention were not disclosed in the initial reporting.
dek: The prominent journalist Abed Abu Shehadeh, a Palestinian citizen of Israel, has been released from Israeli custody after five days in detention.
title: Israeli authorities release Palestinian journalist after five-day detention
